company: T&K Dryer Vent Cleaning & Air Duct Cleaning Services Inc.

reviews.text: I’m very satisfied with the service I received from T&K Dryer Vent Cleaning & Air Duct Cleaning Services Inc.. I reached out for a dryer vent cleaning, but Camden suggested a dryer vent inspection first to make sure nothing was overlooked.
reviews.author: Brayden V.

reviews.text: I was impressed by the service from T&K Dryer Vent Cleaning & Air Duct Cleaning Services Inc. Henry performed a complete dryer vent inspection and found significant lint build up that could have become dangerous if left untreated.
reviews.author: Shei R.

reviews.text: Reliable and competent! The meticulous cleaning of their dryer vent and air ducts improved the quality of the air. The roofing contractor performed a superb job, and the chimney sweep and repair were effective.
reviews.author: Zamani J.
